Population increased in Wiltshire

The estimated population of Wiltshire in 2024 was 523,700 usual residents, a rise of 0.8% since 2023.

This meant that Wiltshire's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Wiltshire increased by 2%.

Over this slightly longer period, Wiltshire was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Wiltshire

The average (median) age stayed at 44.8 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Wiltshire has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Wiltshire is an area that is classed as intermediate rural in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Wiltshire's population of 523,700 usual residents was made up of:

  • 91,708 people aged 0 to 15 years, (17.5%)
  • 311,841 people aged 16 to 64 years, (59.5%)
  • 120,151 people aged 65 years and over, (22.9%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Wiltshire has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (22.9% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Wiltshire, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Wiltshire
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Wiltshire, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 811 people (-0.2%). In total, there were 4,316 births and 5,127 deaths in Wiltshire.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 2,795 (0.5%). There were 25,297 people entering the area and 22,502 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Wiltshire's population of 2,177 (0.4%) as a result of 3,906 people entering the area and 1,729 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Wiltshire was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Wiltshire in mid-2023 is 519,779.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 891 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 909 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 1,800 people.
